falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,150 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 38 suggests controlled stress near a capitulation threshold; sustained VIX >35 indicates genuine panic rather than the measured washout the pattern requires, breaking the bottom formation logic

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 5.00% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with rates in a 3.8-4.2% range; a spike to 5%+ would represent a fundamentally different macro regime (renewed inflation scare or sovereign stress) that the historical pattern did not price in

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
